candidates.source_description: The Mirage is a family of jet aircraft designed by the French aerospace company Dassault Aviation. Known for their sleek design, advanced technology, and exceptional performance, Mirage aircraft have been a cornerstone of military aviation since the 1950s. The Mirage III, one of the earliest and most iconic models, played a pivotal role in the air forces of many countries.
